primary_input.alignment: full row-for-row; SAM PLY and carrier PLY have identical SHA256

frozen_method.renderer: RADIO-GS FeatureFieldRenderer on the frozen room carrier
frozen_method.score_resolution: frozen renderer feature_height x feature_width, bilinear resize to protocol mask resolution
frozen_method.reference_candidate_policy: maximize reference-mask foreground IoU; deterministic lowest candidate index on ties
frozen_method.reference_threshold_grid: 0.99, 0.98, ..., 0.03 descending; deterministic first threshold on strict improvement
frozen_method.target_policy: the selected candidate and threshold are fixed before any target mask is opened
frozen_method.target_rgb_access_provenance: The persisted SAM field was generated transductively from all registered RGBs; this is disclosed and is the component under attribution.

execution_order: validate hashes and exact primitive row alignment
render and persist all three reference score maps
select candidate and threshold from the reference mask only and persist a receipt
render and persist every target score map
only then open target masks and compute foreground IoU

interpretation_gate.expansion: If the room delta is at least 0.03, run truck as an explicitly incomplete-row diagnostic with both zero-fill and valid-mass-normalized rendering. Lego remains blocked on re-uplifting onto the current carrier.
